summary: Native Core -> ETF -> BEAM compile:forms(from_core) gives byte-identical .beam for every SDK descriptor (2438/2438). The descriptors come from the BEAM front end (BeamLisp.AOT prepare_unit); no unit goes through a native front end yet.

sdk.note: main's SDK did not build on 2026-11-22 (63c1a4a1d); the integration worktree's client and SDK were used

native_changes.etf: erlang/term_to_binary/1,2 and binary_to_term/1,2 on the native host (host/native-data-bifs.scm); removed from the BEAM-only refusal list (host/host-compiler.scm)
native_changes.bytes: non-UTF-8 binaries are a host value #(bytes BV): is_binary/is_bitstring true (leaf and emitted intrinsic, src/native/intrinsics.bl), byte_size counts bytes; text operations still take strings only

step1_etf.comparison: erlang/=:= on BEAM between its own term and binary_to_term of the native bytes
step1_etf.not_covered: float 5.0e-324 (a denormal literal) aborts the native host in make-string (255.0); a native number-printing bug, outside ETF

step2_driver.compile: lower/module->beam: compile:forms(Core, [from_core, binary, return, {source, File}]) plus canonical-beam, the exact path BeamLisp.Emit/compile_descriptor runs (lower.bl:518)
step2_driver.core_check: native Core =:= BEAM lower/module->core of the same descriptor

step3_corpus.unit_store_difference: Every descriptor beam differs from the unit store only in chunks that carry the build sandbox's source path /build/home/.cache/beam_lisp/aot/sdk-build/a39ac6ee.../beam_lisp-0.1.0/priv: CInf in all 2438, plus Line, LitT and Attr in subsets (777 Attr+CInf+Line, 673 Attr+CInf+LitT, 660 Attr+CInf+Line+LitT, 267 CInf, 61 Attr+CInf). Code, atom, export, import and fun chunks are identical. A re-preparation outside that sandbox cannot reproduce those paths, so the byte reference is the BEAM backend on the same descriptors.
step3_corpus.beam_recompile_vs_store: compile_unit on BEAM: 58 of 2543 beams equal the store (path-free generated beams)

front-end-not-native.detail: descriptors are built by BeamLisp.AOT prepare_unit / stage-sdk-unit! / describe_module (priv/host/aot.bl, 9650 lines: 125 Process/, 25 ets/, 15 Env fork/with_env, 10 code/, 39 beam_lib/ uses); that namespace is not in the native bundle

generated-in-plan.detail: init helper and macro-value modules compiled inside describe_module; their descriptors are not exposed by prepare_unit

step3_corpus.optimizer: not a blocker: BeamLisp.Optimize/module (priv/host/optimize.bl, native namespace host.optimize, 1008 lines) ran natively for all 2438 descriptors
